hooks.command: grep -q '^replace' go.mod 2>/dev/null && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"go.mod has a local replace directive (from go.mod.dev) pointing at machine-specific paths \u2014 remove it before committing. See AGENTS.md \u0027Local development with content changes\u0027."}}' || echo '{}'
hooks.statusMessage: Checking go.mod for local replace directives...

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *"/layouts/"*|*"/content/"*) hugo --quiet --destination /tmp/hugo-hook-check 2>&1 | head -40 ;; esac; } || true
